entry_long: On Saturday (dayofweek==7): long if the BTCUSDT perp daily candle is green; short if red.
entry_short: Saturday and daily candle red -> short.
exit: Long exit at +0.7% from entry or when dayofweek changes (<7 i.e. Sunday). Short exit at entry*0.093 (script value looks like typo for 0.993) or day change.
take_profit: Long +0.7%; short target as coded (0.093 multiplier, likely typo)
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Short take-profit constant looks erroneous; hold only within Saturday.
